jobs.prompt: Owner decision: the hand-build guard must FAIL CLOSED. Today tools/handbuild-guard.mjs fails open on any exception and on a 4 s timeout (exit 0, no output = allow). Change it for the Bash, Edit, Write and NotebookEdit tool calls in a guarded project root: (1) On an exception anywhere in the decision path, or when the watchdog timer fires, print a deny decision (hookSpecificOutput permissionDecision deny) with the exact reason 'guard error: retry or make a ticket (swarm diagnose "<question>" or swarm ticket ...)' and exit 0. Run the decision inside try/catch/finally with a watchdog (setTimeout, unref'd is NOT ok: it must fire) that writes the deny and exits; make sure only one decision is ever printed. Raise the watchdog from 4 s to 15 s (a constant GUARD_TIMEOUT_MS, env override SWARM_GUARD_TIMEOUT_MS for tests only, bounded 50 ms..60000 ms) and keep normal commands far below it (measure the 95th percentile on the existing test commands in a test and assert it is under 1 s). (2) The owner kill switches stay exactly as they are and are checked FIRST, in a tiny separate try block before anything that can throw: the handbuild off file, the orchestrator-mode off file, worker cwd (isWorkerCwd) and scratch/test roots exempt as today; if those cheap checks themselves throw, deny. If the project root cannot be determined at all, allow (nothing to guard; not a project). (3) An oversized hook input (the existing truncated-input path) already denies: keep. (4) Every crash and every timeout is appended as one JSON line to .swarm/handbuild/guard-errors.ndjson (time, tool, error name and message (no command text, no secrets), kind crash|timeout, guard version) and `swarm status` prints a line 'guard errors today: N' when N>0 (read-only, cheap); add the count to the data the board reads, as a plain number guardErrorsToday in the project summary object the board uses (the board owner renders it). Treat it as a swarm bug in the sense that the log is the bug record: also write the first error of the day to the existing lessons or events stream if one exists for orchestrator events (orchestrator-events.mjs appendEvent kind 'guard-error'). (5) Test commands designed to crash and to time out the guard: add a test-only hook point so a test can make guardDecision throw and another make it hang (e.g. env SWARM_GUARD_TEST_FAULT=throw|hang honoured ONLY when NODE_ENV=test or SWARM_GUARD_TEST_MODE=1 is set AND the project root is a temp dir); drive tools/handbuild-guard.mjs as a subprocess: both must produce the deny with the exact message, exit 0, log a line, and the off file must still let the call through; also assert the fault env var is ignored (no effect) outside test mode. (6) FALSE POSITIVE: `head -5`, `tail -5`, `head -20` (numeric shorthand) must be accepted exactly like `head -n 5` when the number is <= 200 and denied above 200 and for -c, -f, -F, --follow, combined flags with f/c. Add tests. Keep all handbuild, self-approval, shell-writes, orchestrator-mode tests passing; update docs where the guard's failure mode is described.
